_comment: Local models every Codespace should have WITHOUT uploading: baked into the dev-container image by .github/workflows/devcontainer-image.yml and, if missing at runtime, fetched by the engine on start (see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md). URL forms: hf://org/repo/file.gguf or a direct https link. Round BD: five models, five slots, all voting at the same time - each one is loaded with its share of the CPU threads (see LocalModelAgent.thread_budget) and a model whose measured vote does not fit the 9 s budget votes every fifth window instead of stalling the others.

models.note: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct Q4_K_M (~1.0 GB) - the strongest structured-JSON voter of the five
Llama 3.2 1B Instruct Q4_K_M (~0.8 GB) - Meta's small instruct model, different training lineage from Qwen
SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct Q4_K_M (~1.0 GB) - HuggingFace's small model, strong on short reasoning
Gemma 3 1B IT Q4_K_M (~0.8 GB) - Google's small instruct model (needs llama-cpp-python >= 0.3.8)
Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct Q4_K_M (~0.4 GB) - the fastest; the one vote that always fits a 2-core budget
